text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today.
As for how Haru Urara is doing...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer!
I put my luggage away! And I changed my clothes!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: You're full of motivation, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Because I have to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
There are races, and training too!
I'm gonna try, try, try my very best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, I'm sure it'll all be fine!
So go ahead and train me super strictly, okay!"

Haru Urara's motivation is the real deal.
In that case, I need to live up to her expectations
and provide her with the right training!
